acceptance_algorithm: If exact populated source-native evidence is unavailable, return BLOCKED; never infer pass from schemas or remote inspection.
Execute R01-R15 and retain every gate receipt.
PASS only when every mandatory gate passes and nontrivial_repository_predicate is true.

PASS certifies only the exact source/release/universe, source snapshot, Git/config and authority snapshot recorded by the run; it does not certify other sources or authorize pooling, retirement, actor effects, deployment or cutover.
